title: Small-Group Pottery & Coffee Night
description: A smaller, beginner-friendly evening at the wheel. A guided intro to throwing your first bowl, then time to glaze, sip coffee and get to know a handful of neighbors who are new to clay too. No experience needed and everything is provided.
format: Guided 60-min beginner wheel session for a small group, then 60 min of glazing and conversation over coffee
intendedSocialExperience: One shared table so everyone in the small group talks to everyone else
whySuggested: Several people nearby are interested in pottery and coffee and are free on Thursday evenings. Interest is an estimate, not a commitment.
assumptionsToValidate: The studio has a wheel for each of about 8 beginners
A smaller group still covers the studio's costs at this price
